input.command:
cd /tmp/obench-cell-3oivsn9t/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_s8vg0r3a; mkdir -p scratch; cat > scratch/validate.py <<'EOF'
import sys, numpy as np, pandas as pd, cv2
inp, out, img = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
a = pd.read_csv(inp, index_col=0); b = pd.read_csv(out, index_col=0)
im = cv2.imread(img); H, W = im.shape[:2]
assert list(a.columns) == list(b.columns) and len(a) == len(b)
acc = np.zeros((H, W), int); vis = im.copy(); bad = 0
for i, r in b.iterrows():
    xs = np.array(list(map(int, r.coords_x.split(',')))); ys = np.array(list(map(int, r.coords_y.split(','))))
    assert xs.min()==r.xmin and xs.max()==r.xmax and ys.min()==r.ymin and ys.max()==r.ymax
    pts = {(x,y) for x,y in zip(xs,ys)}
    if len(pts) <= 4 and len({p[0] for p in pts})<=2 and len({p[1] for p in pts})<=2: print('RECT', i); bad += 1
    m = np.zeros((H, W), np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m, [np.stack([xs, ys], 1).astype(np.int32)], 1)
    n, _ = cv2.connectedComponents(m, connectivity=4)
    if n != 2: print('components', i, n-1); bad += 1
    acc += m
    cv2.polylines(vis, [np.stack([xs, ys], 1).astype(np.int32)], True, (0,255,0), 1)
for i, r in a.iterrows():
    xs = np.array(list(map(int, str(r.coords_x).split(',')))); ys = np.array(list(map(int, str(r.coords_y).split(','))))
    cv2.polylines(vis, [np.stack([xs, ys], 1).astype(np.int32)], True, (255,0,0), 1)
print('overlap px (fillPoly):', int((acc > 1).sum()), 'bad:', bad, 'n:', len(b))
try:
    from shapely.geometry import Polygon
    P = [Polygon(zip(map(int, r.coords_x.split(',')), map(int, r.coords_y.split(',')))) for _, r in b.iterrows()]
    print('invalid:', sum(not p.is_valid for p in P), 'shapely overlaps:', sum(P[i].intersection(P[j]).area > 0 for i in range(len(P)) for j in range(i+1, len(P))))
except ImportError: pass
cv2.imwrite('scratch/vis.png', cv2.resize(vis, None, fx=2, fy=2, interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
pip install -q shapely 2>&1 | grep -v -i -E "notice|warn"; time python convert_masks.py weights/mobile_sam.pt scratch/out demo_rgb.png demo_metadata.csv && python scratch/validate.py demo_metadata.csv scratch/out/demo_metadata.csv demo_rgb.png && head -4 scratch/out/demo_metadata.csv
